title: Best lap of the second generalist seed
explain: The generalist of seed 1, trained by reinforcement learning on generated tracks only, as in the preregistered recipe. This hand-made track was never part of its training, so the lap is generalization: it reads the road ahead and picks a speed for each bend.
why: the highest-scoring finished track of the 5 campaign tracks it finished

caption.What you see: The generalist of seed 1, trained by reinforcement learning on generated tracks only, as in the preregistered recipe. This hand-made track was never part of its training, so the lap is generalization: it reads the road ahead and picks a speed for each bend.
caption.Model: `generalist/seed1`: PPO, trained by reinforcement learning for 1 billion agent steps on 48,949 generated training tracks (seed 1, 1.9 h on one GPU).
caption.Map: Technical (`campaign-04`), a hand-made campaign track, 666 m long with no jumps and up to 5° of banking; this model never saw it during training.
caption.Evaluation: official evaluation in `results/generalist/seed1/eval_campaign.csv` (standing start, most probable action, final checkpoint): finished in 21.60 s; the scripted driver needs 42.52 s, so this is 1.97× its speed. The clip replays this run.
caption.Why this clip: chosen by a fixed rule as the highest-scoring finished track of the 5 campaign tracks it finished in its official evaluation.

title: Best lap of the blind control
explain: The blind control: the same training as the generalist, but its observation keeps only the nearest centreline point, so it cannot see the road ahead. The track was never part of its training; compare its lap with the generalist's, which sees the road ahead (hypothesis H3).
why: the highest-scoring finished track of the 5 campaign tracks it finished

title: Best lap of the single-track ablation
explain: The training-set-size ablation with one track: the standard recipe trained on a single generated track from the pool. The hand-made track was never part of its training; the results compare how far one training track generalizes against the full pool (hypothesis H2).
why: the highest-scoring finished track of the 2 campaign tracks it finished

title: Fine-tuned specialist on its own track (campaign-01)
explain: A specialist made by fine-tuning the seed-1 generalist on this one hand-made track: it starts from a policy that already drives generated tracks and then trains on this track only. The results compare it with the from-scratch specialist and show what it forgets on other tracks.
